[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Rezion]] had a '''daughter''' from [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] who contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in an effort to arrange [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Parent/Legends|father's]] defection from [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. The father wanted to join the Alliance with the notes on an advanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] he was developing along with his daughter.<ref name="Platt's SG" />
